harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 (uid/gid 1000) and applied a PAM limits config at /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf setting nofile (open files) to 8192 and nproc (processes) to 256, both soft and hard. Verified via a login shell (`su -l appworker`) that ulimit -n reports 8192 and ulimit -u reports 256. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, issued a deferred `systemctl reboot` so the ack returned before disconnection, polled until the node was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart, not just a service bounce), and re-verified post-restart that the appworker account, its limits config file, and its effective login-session ulimits (8192 files / 256 processes) all persisted correctly.
actions_performed: Checked appworker did not already exist and identified OS as CentOS Stream 10
Wrote /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf with nofile and nproc soft/hard limits (8192 / 256)
Verified limits take effect in a real login session via su -l appworker + ulimit -n / ulimit -u
Captured baseline boot_id and account/limits state before restart
Triggered systemctl reboot on node1 via a deferred background command so the exec ack returned first
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed boot_id changed post-restart, proving a genuine reboot
Re-verified appworker account, limits config file, and effective ulimits after restart

evidence.summary: Confirmed appworker did not exist beforehand, then created it with useradd -m and verified uid=1000(appworker)

evidence.requirement: Login sessions limited to 8192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: Wrote limits.d config with nofile/nproc soft+hard 8192/256, then verified via a real login shell (su -l appworker) that ulimit -n=8192 and ulimit -u=256
Captured boot_id 45c22b1f-31bf-419b-a1a4-331c4aa1a40a plus confirmed appworker account and limits config present before restart
Deferred systemctl reboot via background sleep+reboot; exec call returned 'reboot-scheduled' successfully before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart proof via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Polling showed connection failures during reboot, then a successful reconnection with boot_id a1dc1a6c-1535-428e-a248-d23633cbd968, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of appworker account and its resource limits
evidence.summary: After restart, getent passwd shows appworker still present, limits.d/appworker.conf unchanged, and su -l appworker ulimit checks confirm 8192 open files and 256 processes still enforced
